effectiveSourceCorrection.original: A report may state a nutrient in parts per million (ppm), or provide a Low, Medium/Optimum or High class. Ppm means one part in a million parts on the stated mass or volume basis. For a mass-of-soil result, 1 ppm can be expressed as 1 mg/kg; a solution result might be mg/L. Do not convert one into the other without the laboratory's reporting basis and calculation.
